rule:

development_sessions of the inputs file, copied into each development session file's 'inputs'). The same rule is
applied per field to the six acceptance days, from the same sources, after both development rows are reproduced
field for field from those sources (the generation stops if one differs):

session_1.hold_source: force: the table's world.hold_force_median_N; torque: the same row of the plant records' hold table, immediate 2022-06-08 (rebuilt command); the maintainers enters the torque
